qualification: Verified payloads plus both CPU/GiB and PSS upper paired bootstrap ratio bounds <=1.02. This is a held-out local screen, not broad qualification of post-link output. All compilation, instrumentation and training complete before scored runs.
decision_rule: Do not promote from three rounds. If either resource has a paired median ratio above 1.02 against its exact input, reject this configuration without spending the ten-round qualification; otherwise run an independent ten-round qualification with a new fixture seed.
adaptation_before_measurement: The post-link functional concurrent multi-file transfer verified, but had unexpectedly high memory. No matched BOLT performance round had run when this triage plan was recorded.
